proposal.learner: Pinned native CHORD PPO; no WM
proposal.controller: Frozen SONIC with all native body and finger residuals
proposal.timing: Retain native G1 50Hz source-frame playback and physics substeps
proposal.learning_rate: Native PPO initial 5e-4, KL-adaptive target 0.02; native five epochs and four minibatches
proposal.curriculum: Adapt DexMachina rolling reward/completion assistance reduction and recovery; replace v1 full-episode pelvis-reference probe gate. Independently score with assistance exactly zero. Map rewards and thresholds explicitly before execution.
proposal.reward_scope: Native task/contact rewards first; leave new wrench-reward term off to avoid coupling changes
proposal.baseline: Existing native FlashSAC corrected checkpoints at 20M, 40M and 60M, plus separately labeled 350M endpoint; report matched transitions and wall time. This is a candidate-pipeline comparison, not isolation of PPO alone.
proposal.decision: Continue only if unassisted score/contact/physical stability improve and assistance actually decreases; if the curriculum stays stuck, diagnose rather than automatically extend. Select checkpoint by prespecified unassisted evaluation and retain every checkpoint.
proposal.timing_note: 75 minutes is a proposed hard allocation cap, not a prediction that PPO completes 60M or converges.

followup_after_signal: If useful, hold the curriculum fixed for matched FlashSAC learning-rate-horizon and update-ratio ablations; do not combine all knobs in the first run.
